items: Your animals keep out of trouble on long trips: far from you on the ground (or from their sigil) they travel quietly along the edges between areas, a little faster, and wild animals leave them be
Close to you on the ground, or near their sigil, they're your posse again and fight as before; they don't drop out mid-fight
While an animal travels, its leash becomes its route: a dotted line on the ground from it to you or its sigil, snaking along the area borders (easy to see from the treetops)
Only your posse eats berries: travellers don't stop for them
